content: rOpenSci README structure: package name, badges (CI/coverage/CRAN/lifecycle/codecov), description with vignette links, installation (CRAN + GitHub), setup, usage demo, comparison to similar packages, citation. Badges between <!-- badges: start --> and <!-- badges: end -->. Cross-linking: @family roxygen tag groups functions, creates See Also sections, drives pkgdown reference grouping. pkgdown: <!-- pkgdown: home: start/end --> controls what appears on site homepage. EventStudy README has badges block, Features list, Quick Start, but missing: comparison section, @family tags not visible in search, lifecycle badge says 'experimental' (should be 'stable' for 0.64.0).
